description: Full GLM-5.3 (744B MoE) on two DGX Sparks with KindlingAI's gr8, a from-scratch CUDA inference engine (no vLLM, PyTorch or NCCL at serve time), at tensor parallel 2 over the ConnectX fabric. The weights are KindlingAI's exlr8 release 0.7 (with its TP=2 index slices) at its bit225 width profile (every routed expert at K2, K3 in 56 layer-tensors, about 2.25 bits a routed weight), int4 MLA latent KV with the KV block in fp8, a 131,072-token KV pool, requests up to 131,072 tokens, four at once, zero-copy shared prefix pages, native INT4 DFlash2 plus MTP=1 drafting with adaptive speculation and a 48 GB SSD KV store (not kept across restarts). The recipe runs gr8's published main image (commit fa5d82d3, by digest) with the settings of kindlingai/recipes' glm-5.3/dgx-spark/2x/exlr8-gr8 kit at a795aa04 and a placement wrapper that reads the platform's VONK_* environment and uses the release in place from the read-only model mounts; the DFlash2 drafter is converted for each rank in native INT4 on its first start. Options: four requests at 128K (the creator's default) or one long request (CAP=135168, SESS=2, the creator's single-request 128K stress setting); DFlash2 or MTP only. Memory is near zero by the creator's design: it measured 0.064 to 0.088 GiB lowest free memory a box (GR8_MEM_MIN=1), so nothing else should run on the two Sparks. About 272 GB of model files a box: each box mounts the width files its manifest reads whole, where the creator range-fetches about 115 GB from Hugging Face; plus a 48 GB KV store file. Thinking is always on in GLM 5.3's template: a request that turns thinking off is accepted: gr8 thinks at the lowest effort and withholds the reasoning, and a small max_tokens can end inside the thinking. Licences, for information: the weights are under Z.AI's GLM-5.3 License (KindlingAI's exlr8 additions also CC BY 4.0), the engine and the recipe MIT, the DFlash2 drafter CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (non-commercial).
title: GLM 5.3 EXLR8 gr8 two Sparks
